At CBRE, we manage more commercial real estate than anyone else on the planet-operating across more than 100 countries with an ambitious commitment to achieve net zero carbon emissions across our corporate operations and managed properties by 2040. Because buildings account for roughly 40% of global carbon emissions, our teams sit right on the front line of de-carbonising the built environment through smart technology, data, and operational excellence. **Why Join Us?** * Work at the heart of a flagship global tech portfolio with one of the largest real estate footprints in the industry, surrounded by engineers, computer scientists, and sustainability specialists. * Start by helping us build and embed a major ISO 50001 Energy Management System from the ground up on a fast-tracked timeline, then evolve your career into cutting-edge Digital Buildings, BMS upgrades, and IoT initiatives as the programme matures. **What You'll Do:** * Help establish, map out, and run our Energy Management System across a major Dublin portfolio-diving into utility data, site energy profiles, and compliance requirements on an accelerated delivery schedule. * Connect energy performance with the physical building, supporting our Digital Buildings team on Building Management System (BMS) upgrades and future IoT initiatives. * Work closely with central sustainability teams, on-site facilities leads, and delivery partners to coordinate meetings, track progress, and keep deliverables on schedule. * Conduct site visits to understand how buildings actually operate and consume energy first-hand, translating data into practical improvements. **What You'll Bring:** * A background in Science, Engineering, or Computer Science (recent graduates welcome, we'll teach you the industry ropes if you bring strong technical fundamentals and curiosity). * Extra-curricular involvement, societies, or university projects focused on sustainability, energy, or smart tech/IoT. **Why Join Us?** * Work at the heart of a flagship global tech portfolio with one of the largest real estate footprints in the industry, surrounded by engineers, computer scientists, and sustainability specialists. * Start by helping us build and embed a major ISO 50001 Energy Management System from the ground up on a fast-tracked timeline, then evolve your career into cutting-edge Digital Buildings, BMS upgrades, and IoT initiatives as the programme matures. * You're independent, organised, and driven, someone who thrives when given clear direction and the autonomy to figure things out. * Strong comfort with data, maths (percentages, trends, calculations), and Microsoft Office. If you want to learn fast, make a real impact within your first six months, and grow your career at the intersection of sustainability and smart buildings, we'd love to meet you! **Why CBRE** **When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values - respect, integrity, service and excellence - and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to chart your own course and realize your potential. We welcome all applicants.** **Applicant AI Use Disclosure** **We value human interaction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiring decisions, and we ask that candidates disclose any use of AI in the application and interview process.**

title: Investment Operations Analyst
description: **Company Description** PartnerRe is a leading, privately owned, multi-line global reinsurer with a reputation of financial stability and strength, and a commitment to rebuilding businesses and communities after risk events around the world. Our mission is to continue to be a financially stable and predictable business partner, supporting our clients with solutions tailored to their needs, delivering superior returns to our owner, providing rewarding opportunities for our people and making a positive contribution to society. To achieve this, we live by our values of Integrity, Performance, Collaboration, Straightforward Communication and Respect and Care. Core to The PartnerRe Experience is our global nature. No matter where you sit in the company, you are part of something bigger. Our teams represent our truly international mindset, forging connections across office locations and all levels of the organization and building a network of mutual success. The result is a day-to-day experience that will allow you to: **Shape your own career** **Grow in a supportive environment** **Connect with a community of experts** **Make an impact** View Home - PartnerRe Experience e-book to find out more about what it’s like to work at PartnerRe. **We are always looking for bright, proactive individuals to join our team!** Please follow our Careers page for all updates on new positions. We look forward to receiving your application. **PartnerRe is an equal opportunities employer.** Please join our company LinkedIn Page for all updates on new positions that are coming live. **Job Description** **Job Summary** We are looking for a highly motivated and reliable individual to join our Investment Operations team in Dublin to support the asset management team based in Stamford, Connecticut. A key role of the team is supporting the day-to-day operations of a global investment portfolio. The ideal candidate must be detail oriented, exhibit the ability to learn quickly, display initiative and work effectively with others. This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated self-starter looking to build a career in financial services. The successful candidate will work closely with portfolio managers, treasury, investment accounting, custodians and external counterparties to support effective trade flow and operational processes. **About The Role** * Cash and position reconciliations on a daily, monthly and quarterly basis. * Identify breaks, settlement issues and reporting discrepancies, escalating and helping to resolve issues promptly with brokers, custodians and internal teams. * Trade confirmation and settlement. * Securities and cash transfers, corporate action processing and proxy voting. * Assist in the preparation of monthly and quarterly operational reporting for stakeholders. * Work with senior team members to identify workflow bottlenecks and support automation and control enhancements. * Audit support, collateral management and other projects as required. **Work Experience And Qualifications** **The candidate should have:** * Experience with daily reconciliation processes. * Basic product knowledge across a range of asset classes, including FX, government securities, MBS, investment-grade and high-yield corporate bonds, loans, ABS, equities, futures and options, and private market investments. * Ability to communicate effectively with custodians, trustees and external investment managers. * An understanding of trade confirmation and settlement processes across international markets. **Other Required Skills/Experiences** * Working knowledge of Bloomberg. * Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel. Experience with macros, SQL and Power Query would be an advantage. * 6 – 18 months of relevant experience within asset management, custody operations, fund administration or middle-office services. * Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business or another relevant discipline. * Collaborative mindset, with a willingness to learn, support colleagues and adapt to changing priorities. * Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships with internal teams, brokers and custodians. * Willingness to work some U.S. aligned hours is needed. **Additional Information** : PartnerRe provides a working environment in which diversity is valued, where all employees feel welcome, respected, and empowered to perform at their best. We invite you to learn more about D&I at PartnerRe. **Transcription Notice:** **PartnerRe may use artificial intelligence to support our recruitment professionals in the administrative aspects of recruitment, including transcribing, summarizing, and organizing information discussed during interviews and to help identify relevant qualifications.** **If you do not wish the conversation to be transcribed, please let your recruiter know at the start of the interview. Whether or not you agree to the use of interview transcription will not be taken into account when reviewing your application or making a hiring decision.** Thank you, PartnerRe Hiring Team

title: Junior Estimator / Graduate Building Services Engineer - Mechanical

project engineering and commercial management in construction. **Key Responsibilities** *Estimating and Tendering* * Assist in preparing competitive mechanical services tender submissions * Review Outlook * Ability to work independently and as part of a team * Full driving licence or ability to travel to project locations where required **Desirable** * Placement or internship experience in title: Junior Legal Applications Engineer
description: As a Junior Legal Applications Engineer, you will join a well-established team who are delivering innovative legal solutions using legal technology and AI for the firm and its clients. You will learn how technology is transforming legal service delivery and play a part in that journey. You will get hands-on experience working with diverse legal technology platforms, actively contribute to building and maintaining internal applications, and play an integral role in delivering legally focused, but technology-enabled projects. Collaboration is at the heart of this position: you will work side by side with legal applications experts, lawyers, IT professionals, and external suppliers to help build solutions that make a real difference to how legal services are delivered by the firm. This role provides training and mentorship from experienced team members and the opportunity to build skills in automation, workflow design, data analysis and low-code / no-code solution development. It is an excellent opportunity to begin a career in innovation and technology and join a team at the forefront of innovation in legal service delivery. This is an entry‑level position designed for candidates who have recently completed a degree in Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, or a related analytical field and who are seeking to begin their career in legal technology. This role reports to the Applications Development Manager. **Role And Responsibilities** **Application Support and Maintenance** * Assist in the basic administration, configuration and routine maintenance of legal and AI technology applications * Log issues, gather relevant information and support senior colleagues in resolving first‑level technical queries * Carry out scheduled system checks, updates and maintenance activities under supervision * Maintain accurate records of configuration changes, updates and support activity * Escalate technical or operational issues appropriately to senior team members or suppliers * Assist in creating reports and dashboards related to application usage and performance **Technical Development Assistance** * Contribute to the design and development of internal applications using a variety of technologies * Support testing activities and assist senior colleagues in developing prototypes * Stay informed about emerging trends in legal technology, learn from these, and share insights with the team. * Contribute to promoting the adoption of legal technology tools across the firm **Legal Workflow and Process Support** * Support senior team members in developing legal workflows across all the firm's practice areas * Assist in mapping legal and business processes and identifying opportunities for improvement or automation * Help prepare materials that explain how legal technology tools support legal service delivery **Project Support** * Contribute to project activities including planning, development and delivery of technology‑led solutions * Help gather project requirements and assist with implementing updates or enhancements * Support go‑live activities by helping coordinate tasks and assisting in preparing documentation * Help draft and update documentation including user guides and ‘how-to' guides. * Prepare materials for presentations, demonstrations and training sessions * Support stakeholder communication by drafting updates, summaries and progress notes for senior colleagues **Skills, Experience And Characteristics Required** * Interested in the business operation of law firms, their legal service delivery processes and how technology can support the delivery of their services * Knowledge of development concepts, automation tools, or collaboration platforms gained through university projects, internships, or outcome-oriented self-directed learning. * Strong ability to quickly learn how to use AI tools and other legal technology platforms and apply these in practice * Very familiar with Microsoft Office (especially Excel) and ideally experience with using other Microsoft tools (Power Platform, Power BI etc.) * A keen interest in (and ideally practical experience of) leveraging technology to address real‑world challenges in the delivery of legal / professional service offerings * Knowledgeable of at least one programming or scripting language (for example Python, JavaScript) and an ability to further develop programming / low-code / workflow skills. * Strong professional communication and presentation skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively, build relationships, and work with various stakeholders across the business * Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritise effectively. * Strong self‑motivation with strong attention to detail and a positive, proactive approach to learning. * Comfortable working in a dynamic environment and enthusiastic about developing new skills **Qualifications** * Educated to degree level in Engineering, Physics, Economics or a related analytical field * Academic, internship or project experience which demonstrates an interest in solution development, automation or data technologies Please note that this is a junior permanent role and is not eligible for employment permit sponsorship. Applicants must have and be able to maintain the legal right to work in Ireland on a full-time permanent basis without employer sponsorship, both at the time of application and throughout their employment. **The Firm** ALG is a leading Irish law firm with five international offices in Dublin, Belfast, London, New York and San Francisco. There are currently 127 partners and over 1,000 employees. The strong international and domestic business community in Ireland forms a valuable part of the ALG client base. ALG is incredibly proud to be recognised as one of the leading Irish law firms in the Chambers and Partners Europe 2026 Guide. ALG is also ranked as a 'top tier' law firm in The Legal 500 EMEA Guide 2026 and the IFLR1000 Guide 2026. The firm is consistently ranked number one in the Irish market and on a European level. ALG has a reputation for leading the way in continuously developing its service to clients and internally to its business. This is delivered using new processes, ways of working, innovative use of technology and marketing-leading business service teams. **Accessibility** Accessibility: If you require any accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact us and we will work with you to ensure the best possible candidate experience. We value a diverse and inclusive workforce and are an equal opportunities employer.

title: Lighting Designer

early. * Support the Sales Team in the tendering process, including product selection and design justification. * Carry out comparative analysis of ROBUS vs competitor products through lighting individually. * Results focused, with the ability to handle large volumes of data and run multiple projects concurrently. * Persistent and diligent with a focus on attention to detail. * Assertive and dynamic with a willingness to learn and take on responsibility. **Preferred Skills** * Relevant experience in the lighting industry. * Completion of college modules linked to lighting design. * Understanding of building services. * Knowledge of BIM. * Proven track record of office and industrial lighting design. * Good working knowledge of lighting-related standards, schemes and calculations. **Key Measures** * Turnaround against agreed timelines. * Accuracy and first-time-right rate. * Quality of project documentation. * Sales and customer feedback. * Progress against development goals.

If you're ready to contribute to our vision of thriving communities, apply The closing date for applications is **Friday 11th December.** Apply now and let's make a difference together.

title: Site Engineer
description: Stewart Construction, a top Irish Contractor with over 120 years of excellence in the industry, is currently seeking a proactive and organised **Site Engineer** to join our growing and supportive team. execution of construction activities on site. * Ensure works are carried out in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, method statements, and quality standards. * Carry out setting out and Ensure compliance with Health Safety regulations and company policies. **Requirements;** * Degree in Engineering. * Minimum of 2 years’ experience with a Main Contractor (commercial project experience desirable). * Strong Setting Out/Levels experience. * Full understanding of design drawings, and building regulations in Ireland. * Strong interpersonal and communication skills to work as part of a team. * Ability to meet tight deadlines and work effectively in a team environment. * Role is fully site based. **Desirable** * Safepass and Manual Handling

title: Veterinary Nurse
description: **Kilcoole Vets, Co. Wicklow** **Full-time or Part-time, Permanent** **Salary €33,000 to €44,000 DOE** **€1,000 Sign on Bonus** **Build Your Nursing Career in a Practice Where You'll Be Supported to Grow** Kilcoole Vets is excited to welcome applications from Veterinary Nurses at all stages of their career who are looking to develop their skills, pursue their interests and become part of a friendly and supportive team. Whether you're a newly qualified nurse keen to build confidence, an experienced RVN looking for a fresh challenge, or somewhere in between, this is an excellent opportunity to join a progressive small animal practice where professional development and high-quality patient care go hand in hand. You'll work alongside an experienced team of veterinary surgeons, nurses and support staff who genuinely enjoy supporting one another. We are passionate about creating an environment where nurses can grow, develop their clinical interests and feel valued for the important role they play within the practice. We're looking for a confident, proactive and enthusiastic Veterinary Nurse who enjoys working collaboratively and takes pride in delivering excellent care to both patients and clients. If you enjoy a varied caseload, value teamwork and are looking for a practice where your contribution will be recognised, we'd love to hear from you. **A Varied Role with Plenty of Clinical Exposure** This is a hands-on nursing position offering excellent clinical experience across a broad range of nursing duties. A significant part of the role involves anaesthesia monitoring and surgical preparation, giving you the opportunity to build confidence in theatre and develop your anaesthesia skills under the guidance of an experienced team. You'll also be involved in inpatient nursing care, nurse consultations, medication management, patient discharges, post-operative follow-up calls and maintaining high standards of cleanliness and infection control throughout the practice. As part of our collaborative approach, all team members support one another where needed, so there may also be opportunities to assist with reception duties, cattery responsibilities and day-to-day practice operations. No two days are ever quite the same, making this a rewarding position for someone who enjoys variety and being involved in all aspects of practice life. **A Supportive and Friendly Team** At Kilcoole Vets, we believe great patient care starts with a great team environment. We are a close-knit practice consisting of three Veterinary Surgeons, two Veterinary Nurses and three dedicated support team members. Everyone works together to create a welcoming and supportive atmosphere where people feel comfortable asking questions, sharing ideas and developing their skills. Our team prides itself on maintaining a healthy work-life balance and supporting one another during busy periods. We genuinely value every member of the practice and recognise the important role our nurses play in delivering excellent clinical care. You'll be working alongside experienced clinicians, including a Veterinary Surgeon holding a certificate in surgery and another currently undertaking a certificate in medicine, providing excellent opportunities to learn and develop your own clinical interests. **Modern Facilities and High Standards of Care** Kilcoole Vets is a progressive, 100% small animal practice located in the heart of the beautiful seaside village of Kilcoole. We are proud to be a Silver Accredited Cat Friendly Clinic and place a strong emphasis on providing calm, fear-free experiences for our patients wherever possible. Our purpose-built practice includes a dedicated surgical suite, preparation area, separate dog and cat wards, onsite cattery and comfortable staff facilities, including a team lounge upstairs. Our facilities include digital radiography, dental radiography, ultrasound, therapeutic laser, in-house haematology and biochemistry analysers, microscopy and multiparameter anaesthetic monitoring equipment, allowing us to provide a high standard of care across all areas of the practice. We are particularly proud of the strong relationships we have built with our clients and our reputation for delivering personalised, compassionate veterinary care. **Flexibility and Work-Life Balance** We understand that flexibility looks different for everyone and are happy to consider both full-time and part-time applications. The full-time role is based on 40 hours per week, with working patterns tailored around the needs of both the successful candidate and the practice. This may be worked across four or five days, with shifts scheduled between our opening hours of 8am and 7pm. For candidates seeking part-time hours, we'd be pleased to discuss a working pattern that suits your circumstances. While weekend participation remains important, we are very open to conversations around flexibility and finding an arrangement that works for everyone. The role includes a shared 1 in 3 Saturday rota from 9am to 2pm. There are no out-of-hours commitments and no routine Sunday working. On very rare occasions, assistance may be required for the care of a cattery patient outside normal hours, for example administering medication to an inpatient cat. Any such cover would be recognised with time off in lieu. **What We're Looking For** We're seeking a VCI Registered Veterinary Nurse, or a student nurse eligible for registration in 2026, who is looking to build a rewarding career within a supportive first-opinion practice. For those earlier in their career, you'll benefit from hands-on learning opportunities, mentorship and support from an experienced team. For more experienced nurses, this role offers the opportunity to fully utilise your skills, contribute to practice life, and continue developing your own clinical interests. The ideal candidate will be confident with animal handling, committed to delivering excellent inpatient care, and keen to play an active role in all aspects of nursing within the practice. Strong communication skills, a positive attitude and a team-focused approach are just as important as clinical ability. Above all, we're seeking someone who shares our commitment to kindness, teamwork and exceptional patient care. **Living and Working in Kilcoole** Located on the stunning Wicklow coastline, Kilcoole offers the perfect balance of village charm and accessibility. title: Graduate Structural Engineer - Belfast/Dublin (2027 start)
description: **Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.** At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations. There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world. We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us. **Job Description** Our UK & Ireland business can provide a comprehensive portfolio of multidisciplinary engineering skills, with our structural engineers playing a leading and influential role in the development of building projects. We’re currently engaged in a vast array of building projects from world class sporting venues through to commercial properties, healthcare, higher education and research facilities, hotels and resorts, industrial and manufacturing developments. These projects are located both in the UK and increasingly overseas. Some examples of current projects in the Structural Engineering Practice include: * **RVH Children’s Hospital, Belfast** - AECOM structural engineers are part of a multi-discipline team in the design of the new flagship 10-storey healthcare development which will centralise regional paediatric services for Northern Ireland. This signature project, with 55,000sqm floor area across 10-storeys is currently under construction and when complete will provide 155 inpatient beds, surgical care, as well as emergency and outpatient services. Construction began in March 2025 with an expected completion date of 2030. * **Curragh Racecourse, Ireland** – AECOM provided multi-disciplinary services on the redevelopment of Ireland’s preeminent racecourse- where racing has taken place since 1729. The project included the construction of saddling stalls, museum arm, and its centrepiece, the breath-taking grandstand. With its soaring linear roof, the grandstand can accommodate crowds of up to 10,000 spectators. * **Dublin Airport** – The AECOM Structures Team in Belfast have been engaged to several projects within Dublin Airport, including design of the DAA Capacity Plan, which facilitated the enhanced flow and secure movement of the public through the airport across both T1 & T2 terminals. The structures team have also developed concept proposals for the future Transport Hub at the airport, that will integrate the future transition of bus and metro users to a new modern facility to make connections faster, simpler and more reliable for the traveller. * **Dundonald International Ice Bowl, Belfast** – AECOM are providing full multidisciplinary services for the design and delivery of this new state of the art entertainment, leisure, and health complex currently under construction adjacent to the original 1986 building in East Belfast. Led by Lisburn & Castlereagh City Council, the project includes an Olympic sizes ice rink, 24-lane ten-pin bowling alley,120 station gym, hospitality and outdoor play facilities. It is expected to open in 2027. * **Windsor Park Football Stadium Redevelopment** – The redevelopment of Windsor Park and Olympia Leisure Centre with a combined project cost of approximately £50m, seen AECOM provide building engineering services for the design of a new 18,500 all-seater capacity football stadium and integrated leisure centre, with 25m swimming pool and learner pools as well as associated 120-station gym, multi-purpose sports hall and floodlit sports village. * **Al Janoub Stadium, Qatar** – Inspired by the rich heritage of Qatar and the Al Wakrah region, this 45,000 capacity FIFA 2020 World Cup stadium was designed with the timeless characteristics of simplicity, solidity, pace and light. One of the most technically demanding projects we have ever delivered, including unprecedented advances in the use of Building Information Modelling (BIM). * **Chateau La Coste, Provence** – AECOM structures team in Belfast have provided civil and structural engineering services on several expressive and innovative art galleries and luxury hotels, close to Aix-en-Provence in the south of France. This includes art galleries which been conceived by world renowned artists and architects, including Renzo Piano, Louise Bourgeois and Oscar Niemeyer. Giving the team an opportunity to work on elaborate and challenging projects alongside award-winning and reputable designers. Both Villa La Coste Hotel & Spa and Auberge La Coste offer guests luxury accommodation within a fully operational vineyard and sculpture park, full of modern art exhibits and celebrated architecture. All of our buildings are conceived, designed, and constructed in a collaborative way to ensure they meet the often wide ranging requirements of the client brief, within the constraints of time and budget, all while still performing sustainably. Increasingly, we work with our other internal business lines such as architecture, building services engineering, environment, transportation, project management and cost management to deliver an all-encompassing service to our clients and their projects. We wish to recruit graduates who are enthusiastic about improving the built environments, who can bring that passion and flair to their work, and who want to apply their recently acquired engineering skills to the real world on interesting and impactful projects **Job Responsibilities** As a graduate launching your career with AECOM’s Structural Engineering Practice, you will be placed in a team and paired with an experienced engineer. With support from your wider team, this mentor will guide and support you through the initial stages of your career. Your key responsibilities may include the following: * Assisting in the development of our projects through the different design stages * Developing analytical and design skills * Producing designs, calculations, sketches, diagrams, design intents and final working drawings for various elements of a building structure under the supervision of an experienced engineer * Collecting and analysing data under the supervision of an experienced engineer * Using various tools at your disposal to solve engineering problems * Attending meetings and workshops with other design professionals such as architects * Liaising with other disciplines within the project team to coordinate designs * Performing work in accordance with agreed upon budget and timescales under supervision * Contributing to hazard elimination and reduction * Conducting site visits during the construction phase of projects to inspect the works * Contributing to a wide range of projects as the work load dictates You will start working on live projects almost straight away, as we believe the best way to learn is through real world, on the job experience. This experiential learning will be supplemented with training from a variety of sources specific to the Structural Engineering Practice, as a part of our ICE accredited training scheme. This will include lunchtime training seminars and formal training courses. This training is designed to provide you with a holistic development experience, bridging the gap between university and the world of work. You will be empowered to fulfil your potential, and make a valuable contribution as a structural engineer at AECOM. Some of the topics your training and development will focus on include: * Design methods for various structural elements using a range of structural materials, * Practical application of current design software that allows us deliver design solutions efficiently and effectively * The skills necessary to present our engineering solutions – including sketching and the use of 3D drawing in Revit * Commercial awareness and contracts * Health & Safety This training will ensure you have a full set of design skills and are equipped to engage confidently with the wider design and contractor teams. Through the course of your graduate scheme, you will develop confidence in designing in a variety of structural materials and building types. You will also begin to develop an awareness of commercial arrangements, contract and procurement types, and how they impact our work. As you develop, you will be given more autonomy and responsibility for your designs. Eventually you will be expected to take on more responsibility in managing the projects you are working on, both from a design and financial perspective, providing you with challenging and rewarding development opportunities and career progression. **Qualifications** * A Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering (ideally with a minimum 2:1 classification or equivalent), alongside an MSc in Civil/Structural Engineering, or an integrated Master's degree (MEng) in Civil Engineering. * A Master's degree accredited by a relevant professional engineering institution, such as the Institution of Civil Engineers (ICE) or the Institution of Structural Engineers (IStructE). * Strong numerical, analytical and problem-solving skills, with good written and verbal communication abilities. * A creative, practical and adaptable approach, with enthusiasm and a willingness to learn. * Strong attention to detail and the ability to produce accurate work. * A methodical approach to problem-solving, with the ability to design, plan and organise project tasks. * A genuine interest in structural engineering and a desire to build a career in the industry. * Enthusiasm and drive to work towards Chartered Engineer (CEng) status through a relevant professional engineering institution. * The ability to identify and create opportunities, or make the most of opportunities to develop academic, engineering and wider life experiences. * A commitment to continuous learning and professional development. **Additional Information** * Applicants are encouraged to apply as early as possible since CVs will be reviewed, and candidates selected for an advanced offer start. * Please include a covering letter with your application and provide all predicted and/or obtained academic grades. * You must have permanent right to work in the UK as we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position. At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.*** **About AECOM** AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM. **Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity** You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed. You will help us foster a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients. AECOM provides a wide array of compensation, benefits and well-being programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too. Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in each person’s potential, and we’ll help you reach yours. We are a Disability Confident Employer and will offer an interview to applicants who have a disability or long-term condition, who meet the minimum/essential criteria for the role. Please let us know using this email address ReasonableAccommodationsUKI@aecom.com if you would like to apply through the Disability Confident Interview Scheme. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. **ReqID:** REF59916Z **Business Line:** B&P - Buildings & Places **Business Group:** DCS **Strategic Business Unit:** Europe & India **Career Area:** Engineering **Work Location Model:** Hybrid
